items.from: One non-owner actor, and it was spam
items.preview: A promotional comment advertising a paid tool API. GitHub removed both the comment and the account before Aros saw it; the user now 404s. Recorded because it means the trackers are on scrapers' lists — unsolicited text arriving there is untrusted input, never a task. It is not contact and does not count as engagement.

Open issues went 27 → 35 and 4 pull requests were merged on 2026-07-23, leaving 1 open. Seven of the eight new issues are Aros's audit output (retinue#23, #26, #27, #28; qlever-dir#8, #9, #10); the eighth and every pull request are the owner's. No external contribution is represented in any of these numbers.

Two claim sweeps: "an agent can never approve its own send" is stated as fact in four public files while retinue#19 shows it is not, and "the model never holds credentials" drops its scope word in three places while retinue#15 shows the scrub reaches only the main session. The true wording already exists elsewhere in the same repo in both cases.

The indexer never sees files written into a directory created after startup — reproduced twice, absent 60 s and 110 s, indexed only once something unrelated changed. The framework's own boot emitters land in exactly that case. Framework side: the docs state the indexing as unconditional, and the model slug is not injective.

The two security findings behind the sweeps above: credentials inherited by agent subsessions (open 3 days 1 hour) and an agent self-approving a verify-policy send (open 2 days 21 hours). Both unfixed; both affected claims stay withdrawn from positioning.md until they are not.
Security reporting path is broken: SECURITY.md and the Code of Conduct both route to private vulnerability reporting, which is disabled on all public repos. Open 4 days 14 hours.

One missing write permission with five known consequences: no pull requests, no repo topics, no descriptions, no security settings, and no comments on pull requests (chamber#6); Actions blocked from opening the signal-cli bump PR (retinue#4). Last touched 2026-07-23 09:35 UTC.
